support_claim: The registry row associates company number 09338441 with the name VELLUM PRINT CO LTD, and billing records use the name Vellum Print Co Ltd, but no observation links the billing counterparty to that company number.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and name similarity is insufficient; the packet provides no shared identifier or cross-reference tying billing:Vellum Print Co Ltd to registry:09338441. DISTINCT likewise requires evidence of distinctness, which is absent. Neither burden is met, so UNRESOLVED is licensed.
